sentences.text: Thousands of passengers arrived at Charles de Gaulle Airport, collected their luggage, and continued their journeys.
His name was Mehran Karimi Nasseri.
And for the next eighteen years, this airport would become his home.
His story would one day inspire a Hollywood film.
The real one is quieter, sadder, and far less certain.
